coveragePolicy: Both learners demonstrate every catalog concept independently through complementary product work, bounded experiments and unseen variations; no duplicate production implementation is required.

postgresStages.label: No database yet
postgresStages.focus: Use fixture data while mastering JavaScript and TypeScript; agree domain and transport contracts.
postgresStages.checkpoint: Both can explain accepted inputs, state transitions and numeric boundaries.

postgresStages.label: Light foundation
postgresStages.focus: Tables/rows, primary and foreign keys, simple constraints, INSERT/SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE, parameterized queries, a small repository and initial migration. Start a reproducible local database and a small connection pool. Add basic resource authorization with the first endpoints.
postgresStages.checkpoint: Create and read a valid job and part; reject an invalid/unauthorized request. Keep real stock commitment behind the later transaction gate.

postgresStages.label: Everyday product queries
postgresStages.focus: Joins, filtering, ordering, aggregates and stable pagination; extend the schema for pending requests and attachment metadata. Use constrained, small migrations. Learn a basic index from an actual list query rather than adding indexes everywhere.
postgresStages.checkpoint: Both independently write and explain a feature query and its data constraints; client screens consume its actual result.

postgresStages.label: Heavy correctness work
postgresStages.focus: Atomic multi-step transactions, conditional updates/row locks, isolation, concurrent reservations/completions, deadlocks and bounded retries, idempotency keys/fingerprints and unique constraints. Separate pool wait time from query time.
postgresStages.checkpoint: With stock 5, concurrent requests for 3 and 3 accept at most one; stock never becomes negative. Replay of an accepted request has no duplicate effect. Both demonstrate different transaction paths.

postgresStages.label: Offline reconciliation
postgresStages.focus: PostgreSQL version checks, optimistic concurrency, audit/conflict records and durable server receipts. Distinguish these from the device's local database transactions and migrations.
postgresStages.checkpoint: An offline stale completion/reservation produces an explicit domain conflict; retries preserve accepted work and audit history.

postgresStages.label: Reliable delivery and scale
postgresStages.focus: Transactional outbox, consumer deduplication, event cursors, report/database cursors, streaming and bounded buffering; investigate indexes/query plans on the real event/report workloads.
postgresStages.checkpoint: Crash after database commit does not lose eventual event delivery; duplicate deliveries do not duplicate effects; export memory stays bounded.

postgresStages.label: Heavy performance and recovery work
postgresStages.focus: EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE on safe representative workloads, index selectivity/tradeoffs, contention and pool sizing, migration/backfill safety, database privileges, backups, restore verification and recovery objectives.
postgresStages.checkpoint: Both measure and improve a different query/transaction, then recover data and verify business invariants after a migration or failure.

postgresStages.label: Mastery under change
postgresStages.focus: Backward-compatible schema evolution, compensating operations, auditability and diagnosis of unseen concurrency/performance/recovery failures.
postgresStages.checkpoint: Each independently defends a database decision and solves a new product incident; accepted data remains correct.
